text: まけた　くらいで　はらは　たてんよ

structure.en: over something as small as losing

patterns.name: 〜くらいで
patterns.explanation: くらいで after a verb means 'over something as small as that'. まけた　くらいで = 'just because I lost'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is an old-man or dialect form of ない, 'not'. はらは　たてん = はらは　たてない = 'I don't get angry'.
